sessions.summary: Created 7 Google Business Profile images for FMSG using HTML+CSS converted to PNG via Puppeteer. Includes logo, cover photo, 3 post images (AI matching, CV upload, SA focus), and 2 product mockups (dashboard, how-it-works). All files in gbp-images/output/.

Preserve job board context when logged-in user is redirected from /jobs/[category] to /dashboard. Pass board slug via ?board= query param, dynamically import board data on dashboard, display board jobs at top of search tab.

Added 11 static job cards: finance (Sanlam JP Manager, Premier FMCG Payroll Admin, Absa Claims Assessor, FNB Compliance), technology (Old Mutual Data Scientist + Manager Data Engineering), logistics (FlySafair), commercial (HEINEKEN), life-sciences (UP Deputy Dean), new 'ngo' board (UNICEF Partnerships Officer + Chief Health & Nutrition). Verified tsc/eslint/build, committed f582b47, pushed to production.

Added Nedbank Problem Manager II static job card on a new 'technology' job board (ITIL/ServiceNow IT problem-management role, Johannesburg). Verified tsc/eslint/build, committed 65e4d70 and pushed to production.

Created Account Developer job card for Coca-Cola Beverages SA on a new 'commercial' board; removed 3 pre-existing demo job cards (esco-country-manager, senior-tax-manager, dsv-senior-manager-projects-engineer).
Fixed search profile changes not persisting + progress bar incremental count

Fixed 13 issues: search profile persistence, progress bar, PF resume with fresh profile, CV extraction, PF title ladder, connection timeout modal, PF show results now, ATS URL tracking, filtered summary pauses, bebee blocklist
Added deadline awareness throughout entire pipeline (240s threshold), added search phase pauses between PF rounds with user confirmation

Replaced AI scoring pipeline with deterministic in-app ATS scoring (ESCO/O*NET taxonomies, weighted pillars, hard gates), switched verdicts to Apply/Consider/Don't apply, committed + pushed to production as 3baa65a. User confirmed: much faster (68 jobs in 3s), decent scoring
Made ATS per-job scoring progress visible in Vercel logs (was gated behind DEBUG=true via debugLog), added verdict-distribution summary per run. Deployed as 20abd4d

Phase 2: pgvector dense embeddings + Reciprocal Rank Fusion over deterministic ATS scoring for better synonym/phrasing recall. Implemented ats-embeddings.ts, migration 035, RRF fusion (0.85 lex + 0.15 dense) in search route; tsc/build pass, smoke-tested, committed 58aa954 pushed to production. Migration 035 must be applied on Supabase.

Deleted mqhele03@gmail.com's profile data + 73 storage CVs via curl.exe + service key (PowerShell proxy 401 fixed by using curl). Documented Supabase direct-access workflow: REST CRUD, Storage API, Auth Admin API; DDL needs dashboard/Management token. Key stored per request; .opencode/ gitignored.

Deterministic spec dedup around ATS (no AI): 100% keyword-fingerprint match collapses duplicate specs at start of screenAndAnalyze each PF round + cross-round from total; longest spec / highest source priority kept; offset remap fixed for resume via outputs fingerprints. 13-sim-scenario validation, tsc/build pass, committed + pushed to production.

Removed mid-round screening checkpoint + PF search-phase pause (slow-AI Vercel-timeout workarounds, obsolete with fast ATS). Fixed root cause of stuck resume 0d2f1bc6: pfScoringPhase resume never rebuilt titleChainSteps -> TypeError. tsc/eslint/build pass, -250 lines. Committed + pushed to production as 55a4ab2. User confirmed the fix works on deployed site.

Added individual job detail pages at /jobs/[category]/[slug] with SEO metadata, JSON-LD JobPosting schema, and card preview mode. Cards now show snippet (~410 chars) + View Job button instead of full description. Dynamic sitemap replaces static file. 13 static job pages pre-rendered as SSG. Committed 3f00983, pushed to production.

Fixed back navigation from job detail page — stores source path (global vs category board) in localStorage when View Job is clicked, reads it on detail page mount to set correct back link destination. Prevents always defaulting to category board.

Deleted Account Developer (Coca-Cola CCBSA) and Airport Operations Specialist (FlySafair) job cards. Moved to recycle_bin, removed from index files, updated commercial board search pre-fill. Updated JobDetail expired state to show red 'This job has expired' banner — auto-triggered for any deleted card via App Router blocking fallback.
